USE IT IF YOU WANT TO WASTE YOUR TIME. I’d give zero stars if I could. My eSIM didn’t work after downloading, so I contacted support. The chatbot made me check settings and send screenshots, and nothing worked. When I asked for a human, the AI just made me repeat the same steps. They eventually brought in a human agent, who made me redo everything again, even though it was all in their system.

After hours of this, I gave up and bought a SIM from another brand. I told them I only wanted a refund, not a fix. But they switched me back to AI (without telling me) and asked me to repeat the same steps yet again, not processing refund. By then seven hours had passed. When I tried to end the chat, the AI asked me to redo everything once more.

No real problem-solving, no refund, and they swapped a human for AI without notice. Worst service I’ve ever had. They’ll waste hours of your time and still won’t fix anything. Do not use this provider.
